positive_snippets:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Outstanding Stay – Truly a Royal Experience!
I stayed at Orana Aurnam Hotel for 6 days during my Delhi tour, and it was truly a wonderful and memorable experience. From the moment I checked in till checkout, everything was absolutely outstanding.
The staff deserves special appreciation — extremely polite, attentive, and genuinely caring. They take guest comfort seriously and pay attention to even the smallest details at a micro level, which really makes you feel special and valued.
The rooms are spacious, very clean, and super comfortable, perfect for a long stay. The food quality and breakfast spread were excellent, fresh, and well-prepared every day. The location is very convenient, making travel around Delhi easy, and the ample car parking space is a big plus.
Both check-in and check-out processes were smooth and hassle-free, showing how well-organized the hotel management is. Throughout my stay, the team made me feel truly royal and ensured a super comfort level that is hard to find.
I honestly don’t have enough words to describe their outstanding hospitality and guest-focused approach.
Highly recommended for anyone planning a stay in Delhi — whether for business or leisure. I would definitely choose Orana Aurnam Hotel again without a second thought.
⭐ 5/5 – Exceptional in every aspect.....

negative_snippets:
NEVER STAY HERE!
One word: Rubbish place.
During my stay- The staff was extremely unprofessional and argumentative when requested to address basic concerns.

Music was played well beyond the permissible Delhi noise regulation limits, continuing until 2:00 AM. Around midnight, I called the reception requesting them to reduce the music volume and also asked that the housekeeping staff working on the third floor (right behind my room) keep the noise down. Unfortunately, there was NO response or action taken. Loud arguing, abusive language, and the sound of crockery continued throughout the night.

At 2:00 AM, when I personally requested the staff member on my floor (third) to reduce the noise, he responded rudely: “Yeh toh aise hi hota hai, toh ab kaam na karein? Manager ko bula lo itna hi hai toh.” The manager of the hotel never showed up despite the situation.

On 19th February, 2:15 am  (early morning duty), when I called reception again to report the issue, the staff member casually responded, “Arey haan haan, abhi aate hain,” but no one ever came.

My sleep was completely ruined, and no one took responsibility for managing the disturbance.

I strongly advise against organizing any function or staying at this hotel. The staff behavior and lack of accountability are unacceptable.

We hosted our wedding at Orana Aurnum. About 10–12 days before the event, we visited the venue and sat down with Robin, the manager. During that meeting, we finalized all the elements for the bridal entry—like smoke bubbles, a glass walkway, and a few other details—and clearly confirmed everything from our side. At that point, it was the manager’s responsibility to record everything accurately and inform us of any extra charges (which he did mention, and we agreed to).

However, on the wedding day, none of the things we had discussed were arranged. When we contacted the manager, he shifted the blame onto us, claiming we hadn’t confirmed or paid for any additional services. This was extremely disappointing, especially because we had already given our approval. Expecting WhatsApp confirmation—something he never communicated to us—is not a professional way to handle clients, and using that excuse on the wedding day felt unacceptable.

The only reason I’m giving 2 stars is because the food was excellent and the staff was polite. Otherwise, please be extremely cautious when planning your special day here.

Rating: ★★★☆☆☆ (3.5/5)

I recently visited Orana Aurnum Mayapuri, and my experience was generally positive, though there were a few things that could be improved.

Starting with the staff, Himanshu, Rajkumar and Rojit really stood out for their friendly and attentive service. They were both welcoming and ensured that we felt comfortable throughout our visit. Their professionalism was much appreciated, and they made the experience more pleasant overall. Kudos to both of them!
Food quality was great, additionally, there were a couple of delays with our order, and while the staff was quick to apologize and explain, it did affect the overall timing of our meal. Not a major issue, but worth noting. One downside was the lack of laundry services, which was a bit of an inconvenience during my stay.

Overall, Orana Aurnum Mayapuri is a good choice for a casual outing, especially if you're looking for good service and a pleasant ambiance. However, there’s definitely room for improvement when it comes to food consistency and efficiency. I would still recommend it, but with the expectation that it may not blow you away.
